mapper.select: SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, a.VAL_DATE AS valueDate FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION a WHERE a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and a.VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, b.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, a.INPUT_TYPE AS inputType, a.VAL_DATE AS valueDate, a.VALUATION AS valueAsset FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION a left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE = b.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE b.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.insert: insert into FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION (FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, PUBLISH_DATE, VAL_DATE,VALUATION,INPUT_TYPE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{publishDate,jdbcType=DATE}, STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{valueAsset,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, '01', #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.delete: delete from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDate} ,'%Y-%m-%d') and FINPROD_TYPE= 'F17'
mapper.update: update FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION set VALUATION= #{valueAsset}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FINPROD_TYPE='F17' and VAL_DATE= STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
